root_guard_contract: Verify current v16 startup/source pins and Windows model owner binding before inference.
Allow an existing DISABLED speech job only with explicit PAUSED, mic=false, no pending turn. Do not alter user pause.
Keep existing production UI and camera running with unchanged owners; do not restart services or open microphone/speaker.
Require Windows model idle before starting; record aggregate counts and background changes afterward without assuming accepted counts increase exactly once.
Use an owned child process with external timeout 80 seconds plus at most 5 seconds kill grace, bounded below 90 seconds; save both success and failure metadata.

After worker exits, recheck UI/camera/Windows owners and PAUSED/mic=false; verify no owned model work remains, especially if hard timeout prevents Python finally. Do not cancel unrelated summary jobs.
measurements: One ASR constructor including hash verification/native import/model load is timed separately; this is not warmed steady state.
One ASR decode is followed by the actual recognized public text through formal NegotiatedDialogueClient ABC and complete canonical reply validation.
Formal split_sentences preserves the full validated reply; complete sentence TTS requests run in order. No old 48-character/name assertion or arbitrary two-request count is used.
Record ASR completion to complete validated text, first complete sentence RAM audio, and complete reply RAM audio. Record ASR decode start equivalents.
RAM PCM format/length/hash and all owned response identities are formally validated. Only counts/hashes/timing/numeric model metrics are output.
First RAM audio means first sentence fully synthesized, received and validated; it is not a streaming packet or speaker onset. No capture/VAD/playback/ACK/Store/permission action is exercised.
cancellation: Register each exact owner before request; outer try/finally cancels every owned LLM/TTS request, including transport/contract failures. Unconfirmed cleanup cannot report PASS. Root handles owned child hard timeout separately.
